method: Assistant re-review of fixed English source, existing human/project references and both fresh translations. Not a blinded human study. Earlier CUNI grades retained where still appropriate; overrides below are explicit. Q3/Q8 timing in this preflight is NOT an OCR/VFG coexistence measurement.

008.note: Q8 preserves 'in sight of the city gates'; Q3 says 'on the edge of the gates'.

028.note: Q8 turns ongoing repelling into a completed action; Q3 preserves the ongoing progress.

031.note: Q8 gives a more natural Czech exclamation 'Už zase ona!' with the same urgency.

036.note: Meaning is preserved; 'krutě studená' is an awkward collocation compared with natural Czech descriptions of bitter cold.

051.note: Q8 keeps a literal thunder-stick rather than Q3's lightning rod, but the terminology and Knalga inflection remain awkward.

053.note: Fresh Q3 changes deepest parts of the kingdom into the deepest kingdom. Q8 retains the intended location within it.

063.note: Q8 fixes the inconsistent verb forms while preserving both requests.

069.note: Q8 preserves inability to swim, unlike Q3's habitual statement, but still assumes a distance rather than simply crossing the obstacle.

072.note: Literal 'Nejsem cizí tomu břemenu' is awkward Czech; Q3 expresses experience with command naturally.

074.note: Q8 clearly says to avoid the orcs while allowing their fight with Wesnoth; Q3's 'their clash' is ambiguous.

077.note: Reflexive 'svůj zadek' can make the elves guard their own rear instead of Konrad's; Q3 preserves 'your'.

087.note: Q8 omits Asheviere's name, while retaining the queen and execution order.

089.note: Q8 invents 'Gryfany' as the recruitable unit; Q3 correctly names gryphons.

094.note: Fresh Q3 conveys pursuit but moves the dog comparison onto the pursuers and weakens the threat. Q8 retains the nonsensical literal 'Poběžíme vás dolů'.

096.note: Q8 preserves the threat but omits 'now' and has a stray capital I.

113.note: Q8 changes definite ongoing enemy base construction into a guessed completed action, altering the tactical state.

122.note: Fresh Q3 now identifies the landing place, although 'vylodění' is imprecise; Q8 retains unexplained LZ and the same imprecise landing term.

132.note: Q8 retains the perimeter and anti-aircraft defenses; Q3 generalizes the perimeter to the whole area.

137.note: Q8 restores the missing pre-Collapse qualifier.

138.note: Q8 retains detection of forces rather than adding that they are approaching.

150.note: Q8 uses Společenstvo consistently in its Collective lines. With no supplied game glossary, that alternate faction rendering is accepted; Q3 alternates it with Kolektiv.

159.note: Q8 expresses establishing the safe haven naturally and preserves the return to the landing zone.

166.note: Q8 keeps the number and location but omits NASDA and retains the agreement error around one or more missiles.

180.note: Literal 'Prvky týmu' is awkward for a team's members/subunits; Q3 conveys this naturally.

194.note: 'Ozbrojování raket' is an awkward literal rendering of arming/activating missiles; Q3 is natural.

212.note: Q8 uses the Czech odstřelovač and retains the exact location and red door.

229.note: Literal 'extrakční bod' is understandable gaming jargon, less natural than Q3's pickup location.

250.note: Q8 translates the idiom 'dead meat' literally as 'mrtvá masa', an unusable Czech sentence; Q3 conveys imminent death.

253.note: Q8 correctly uses stamina regeneration rather than generic improvement.

254.note: Both fail the equip-ring action: Q3 is malformed and Q8 tells the player to equip the ring itself with resistance.

255.note: 'Léčitelka došla manou' loses the clear statement that the healer has run out of mana and is ungrammatical.

257.note: Q8 restores looting the chest, with a malformed imperative 'Vyplen' rather than Vypleň.

260.note: Q8 restores non-stacking but still assumes the buff is protection.

264.note: Q8 keeps the warning but leaves the direct address Mara uninflected; Q3 uses Maro.

290.note: Q8 correctly expresses dismay at repetition ('Už zase'); Q3 loses the repetition.

297.note: Q8's reflexive 'Drž je od sebe' loses protecting the speaker who is repairing the engine; Q3 also loses the intended protective instruction.
